<!-- pr-reviewer: 638380ddc249e2f8a30f4f6cee335eaeb2084121 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge after the author marks this draft ready.

I read the full diff and checked it against the current upstream main rules.
The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `d80dc6944f912171a06029f635e0450c505d44a9` was clean.
The local trial commit is `02f61fc1f527e97cefc8147feb4f3bc83d13f2a2`.
Its first parent is the PR head shown above.

The change keeps the spindle speed refusal on both speed fields.
Spindle power keeps its own refusal key.
The validator and the save checks do not change.
The new test checks the reported case, refusal placement, and invalid spindle power.
The body gives a reason for the separate test file.

Local results:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 4 steps passed; 0 failed |
| App unit tests | 311 passed |
| `machine_edit` | 13 passed |
| `machine_field_refusals` | 1 passed |
| `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` | 6 steps passed; 11 tests passed; 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -j 16 --no-deps --all-targets -p camcraft-app -- -D warnings` | Passed |
| `git diff --check upstream/main HEAD` | Passed |

Extra suites run: the light lane ran `motion` unit tests, `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`, and `app::pocket_pass_start`.
The diff changes no fixture, importer, post, operation, motion, or catalog file.
No extra suite from those paths is required.

Safety check: this change affects refusal placement only.
It changes no posted G-code, gouge check, collision check, stock simulation, or geometry.
Mutations: not run; this is not a safety-tier change.
Goldens moved: none.
The diff changes no `crates/ui` file, so the screenshot requirement does not apply.
Full heavy lanes were not run, as the current upstream rules require.

Requested changes: none.
All commands ran locally. No GitHub runner was used.
I left the labels, title, draft state, and PR branch unchanged, as requested for this review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Please mark this PR ready with `gh pr ready 3985 -R NeoTech/Camcraft` so it can merge on this review.
